scenes.headline: How a finished video gets taken apart, shot by shot
scenes.sub: rea-video, read and tested on clips with known cuts
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Moviola! Give rea-video a finished video and it works back to how each shot was made.

scenes.text: Classical measurements find the shots and test how each was made. A model that can see writes the prompts.
scenes.say: Plain signal processing finds the shots and the evidence. The remake prompts come from a model that can see.

scenes.title: From a video to a remake plan

steps.say: First the video is cut into shots, using tiny gray thumbnails of every frame.
Each shot is measured: repeated frames, sensor noise, whether the picture slides as one flat plane.
That becomes odds over eleven labels, fused with what a vision model or the agent sees.
Each label routes to a recipe: film it, generate it from first and last frames, or rebuild it as code.

scenes.title: How a hard cut is found

items.say: Measure how far the colour histogram moves from one frame to the next.
Add how much the gray pixels changed.
Fire only when that score towers over the half second around it.
Then throw out flashes, where the picture comes back two frames later.

parts.note: per-label weight w on the tools
parts.say: The tools' probability gets a per-label weight. A big weight makes their no count more.
The image reader enters at point seven, cut from one after a confident Gemini overrode frame-rate evidence.

scenes.title: F1 on the fair test clip
scenes.note: My re-typing of the rules, not the shipped tool
scenes.say: On a clip with cuts placed to the frame, the rules scored point nine two. A pixel-difference detector scored point three two.

scenes.label: highest cut score inside a fast pan
scenes.note: half the pixels change, the colours barely move
scenes.say: Inside a fast pan, half the pixels change every frame, yet the cut score stays under point one. Motion does not fire cuts.

scenes.text: Shot boundaries are measured. Prompts are a model's description. Check the short shots first.
scenes.say: The shots are measured. The prompts are a model's description. On my clip a dip to black split in two, so check short shots first.

recap: Signal processing finds shots and evidence
A vision model writes the prompts
Dips and dissolves can split shots
scenes.say: Shots and evidence are measured offline. Prompts need a model that sees.
